DigitalIOItem.Name: IsInHome
DigitalIOItem.Description: True when the robot is currently in the defined HOME position.

DigitalIOItem.Name: IsMastered
DigitalIOItem.Description: True if all axes of the robot are mastered.

DigitalIOItem.Name: IsReadyToMove
DigitalIOItem.Description: True if the robot is ready for motion (No safety stops, drives enabled).

DigitalIOItem.Name: IsActive
DigitalIOItem.Description: True if a motion command (application or jogging) is currently active.

DigitalIOItem.Name: IsReferenced
DigitalIOItem.Description: True if all position and axis torque sensors are successfully referenced.

IOGroup.Description: This group monitors the internal system states of the KUKA LBR iiwa for PLC synchronization.
